request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work (law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, company and plant
documents) using ONLY the documents in the current folder, one text file per document; README.md lists them with their rank. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need: search in English and in Italian, follow references from one article or annex to another, and read the whole section before you rely on it.

Rules:
- Use only the files. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- Answer only if a passage states the answer for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the same article
  and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline). A passage about a neighbouring subject does not
  answer the question: then the kind is "unknown" and the value is null. A question about something that happened
  (the date of the last check, whether something is overdue today) is "unknown" unless a passage records that event.
- A passage marked "corrected by the corrigendum" already shows the corrected wording: reason with it. The old
  wording, given in the mark, is no longer valid.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the passages, one by one. A repeal or an
  application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a date is still fully in
  force on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does not yet bind on earlier days.
- When passages of different rank disagree, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's manual,
  then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.) wins over a
  ministerial decree (DM). Say which one wins.
- A row of a table belongs to the thing named in that same row. Read the row of the item asked about, not a
  neighbouring row. When the question itself states a condition ("if it were in regular use", "built in 2017"),
  reason with that condition.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / by which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "how often / for how
  long / within what time" is "duration"; "can / may / is / does / must" is "boolean"; "which / what (several
  things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition is "text" (one short sentence naming every element asked for).
- Point at the evidence: for every passage you rely on, copy word for word the sentence, or the table row, that
  states what you use. Copy exactly, without changing a character; do not join text from two places.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not state it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "what the passages say and how it leads to the answer, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y", "P6M", "P45D", "PT1H" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "evidence": [{"file": "<file name>", "quote": "<copied exactly from that file, one sentence or one table row>"}]}
request.prompt:
Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: For the verification operations, must IGEA also make the measuring instruments available to the verifier?

What the fact store already holds on this question (facts taken earlier from these same documents, each with the
sentence it comes from). They are leads, not the answer: a fact can be incomplete, about a neighbouring subject,
or wrong. Check each one you use against the files, and search further whenever they do not settle the question.
The store's own answer: false - No. Under the IGEA equipment terms (igea-equipment, p. 4), IGEA makes equipment available to the verifier, but that obligation expressly excludes measuring instruments.
Facts (subject | relation | value | condition | [document, place]):
- IGEA S.p.A. | has obligation | metterà a disposizione del verificatore | if: esclusi gli apparecchi di misurazione | [igea-equipment, p. 4] | sentence: "4.2 Per le operazioni di verifica IGEA S.p.A. metterà a disposizione del verificatore: 4.2.1 Il personale occorrente sotto la vigilanza di un preposto e i mezzi necessari per l’esecuzione delle operazioni stesse (pesi campione), esclusi gli apparecchi di misurazione;"
- Datore di Lavoro/RDRL | has obligation | deve mettere a disposizione dei lavoratori le informazioni ed istruzioni d’uso | if: anche per le attrezzature antecedenti all’emanazione della Direttiva Macchine | [univpm-guideline, p. 7] | sentence: "In ogni caso, anche per le attrezzature antecedenti all’emanazione della Direttiva Macchine, in ottemperanza dell’art. 73 del D.lgs. 81/08, il Datore di Lavoro/RDRL deve mettere a disposizione dei lavoratori le informazioni ed istruzioni d’uso che devono risultare comprensibili ai lavoratori interessati."
- datore di lavoro | has obligation | il datore di lavoro metta a disposizione del verificatore la documentazione tecnica… | [inail-guide, p. 16] | sentence: "Ai fini degli adempimenti di verifica, è essenziale che il datore di lavoro metta a disposizione del verificatore la documentazione tecnica a corredo dell’impianto;"
- Piattaforme di lavoro mobili elevabili e piattaforme di lavoro fuori strada per operazioni in frutteto | verification interval | Verifica triennale (P3Y) | [DLGSALLVII, Allegato VII, riga 3] | sentence: "Piattaforme di lavoro mobili elevabili e piattaforme di lavoro fuori strada per operazioni in frutteto | Verifica triennale"
- aggiudicatario (verificatore): preavviso a IGEA della pianificazione dei controlli | has time limit | 15 giorni (P15D) | [igea-equipment, p. 5] | sentence: "Pianificare i controlli, congiuntamente agli incaricati IGEA, dei diversi apparecchi dando comunicazione a IGEA con un preavviso di almeno 15 giorni"
- uso di una attrezzatura di lavoro | defined as | qualsiasi operazione lavorativa connessa ad una attrezzatura di lavoro | if: Agli effetti delle disposizioni di cui al presente titolo | [DLGS69, art. 69, c. 1] | sentence: "b) uso di una attrezzatura di lavoro: qualsiasi operazione lavorativa connessa ad una attrezzatura di lavoro, quale la messa in servizio o fuori servizio, l'impiego, il trasporto, la riparazione, la trasformazione, la manutenzione, la pulizia, il montaggio, lo smontaggio;"
- datore di lavoro (Plac) | has obligation | la richiesta di prima verifica periodica (punto 2) costituisce adempimento anche per… | if: Per le Plac già messe in servizio alla data del 23 maggio 2012 | [inail-guide, p. 28] | sentence: "Per le Plac già messe in servizio alla data del 23 maggio 2012, data di entrata in vigore del decreto ministeriale 11 aprile 2011, la richiesta di prima verifica periodica (punto 2) costituisce adempimento anche per la comunicazione di messa in servizio (punto 1), come evidente dalla modulistica disponibile sul por- tale dell’Inail."
- distributors of partly completed machinery | has obligation | shall make sure that the corrective actions | if: who consider or have reason to believe that partly completed machinery which they have made available on the market is not in conformity with… | [REG, Art. 16(5)] | sentence: "Distributors who consider or have reason to believe that partly completed machinery which they have made available on the market is not in conformity with this Regulation shall make sure that the corrective actions necessary to bring that partly completed machinery into conformity, to withdraw it or recall it, as appropriate, are taken."
- distributor of partly completed machinery | has obligation | shall not make the partly completed machinery available on the market | if: Where a distributor considers or has reason to believe that partly completed machinery is not in conformity with this Regulation | [REG, Art. 16(3)] | sentence: "Where a distributor considers or has reason to believe that partly completed machinery is not in conformity with this Regulation, the distributor shall not make the partly completed machinery available on the market until it has been brought into conformity."
- distributor | has obligation | shall not make the machinery or related product available on the market… | if: Where a distributor considers or has reason to believe that machinery or a related product is not in conformity with this Regulation | [REG, Art. 15(3)] | sentence: "Where a distributor considers or has reason to believe that machinery or a related product is not in conformity with this Regulation, the distributor shall not make the machinery or related product available on the market until it has been brought into conformity."
- aggiudicatario | has obligation | Comunicare il nominativo del verificatore incaricato | [igea-equipment, p. 5] | sentence: "dei diversi apparecchi dando comunicazione a IGEA con un preavviso di almeno 15 giorni – tempo necessario per la programmazione relativa ai punti 4.1 – 4.2 (impegni Appaltatore);  Rilasciare il verbale di verifica;  Comunicare il nominativo del verificatore incaricato; ."
- lavoratori incaricati dell'uso | has obligation | dispongano di ogni necessaria informazione e istruzione | if: per ogni attrezzatura di lavoro messa a disposizione | [DLGS73, art. 73, c. 1] | sentence: "Nell'ambito degli obblighi di cui agli articoli 36 e 37 il datore di lavoro provvede, affinchè per ogni attrezzatura di lavoro messa a disposizione, i lavoratori incaricati dell'uso dispongano di ogni necessaria informazione e istruzione e ricevano una formazione e un addestramento adeguati, in rapporto alla sicurezza relativamente:"
